items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three equivalent characterizations of an unramified morphism of algebraic stacks, one of them reading the property off an etale presentation over a flat finitely presented cover of the base (author lemma at source lines 8337-8352, label lemma-unramified). The proof (source lines 8354-8402) runs the implications, constructing etale presentations from the DM characterization, checking DM-ness along the cover and, in the last step, reducing to a target that is an algebraic space where unramifiedness of the morphism is equivalent to that of its presentation, with the descent statement closing the argument (proof lines 8354-8401). The construction of the presentations and the final reduction are the substance. H3.
